mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 45, indicating a manufacturing recession, S&P 500 returns tend to be negative over the next 60 trading days as industrial weakness spreads through the economy.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 45 but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4%, signaling a restrictive monetary policy, S&P 500 returns tend to be negative over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs pressure economic activity.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year, signaling a strong housing market, consumer spending and S&P 500 returns tend to be positive over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y HOUST growth > 10% but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and payroll employment (PAYEMS) both decline simultaneously over a 3-month period, signaling a tightening labor market, S&P 500 returns tend to be positive over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE and PAYEMS both decline over 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 3% year-over-year, signaling high inflation, and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2%, signaling that monetary policy is not accommodative, S&P 500 returns tend to be negative over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL y-o-y > 3% and FEDFUNDS > 2% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) decline month-over-month for two consecutive months, signaling a weakening consumer sector, S&P 500 returns tend to be negative over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines m-o-m for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: RSAFS declines m-o-m for 2 consecutive months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
